_note: Maintained by hand in the GitHub editor. Each entry under 'reports' is a scheduled USDA report. Fill estimate_low / estimate_avg / estimate_high (and optionally implied_odds and positioning) from the pre-report trade survey once it publishes (usually 1-2 days before the release). When the range is filled, the page shows the range bar + surprise thresholds automatically. Leave estimate_* as null until you have real survey numbers - do not invent them. After a report releases, move it into wpi-history.json with the actual print.

reports.expectation: The first update to August's survey-based yields. The trade looks for corn to come down from 180.7 to 178.1 bu/acre and soybeans from 52.7 to 52.5, with corn ending stocks cut 120 mb to 1.533 bb and soybean stocks cut 30 mb to 290 mb (Dow Jones survey, via DTN, 2026-09-09). The range bar below is the corn yield survey only.

USDA's fourth survey-based corn and soybean yields of the season, and the first to fold in October's harvest results. The pre-report trade survey usually publishes one to two days ahead; its numbers are typed in from it when it does.
